rationale: Builds directly on the 9x512 recurrent-tail best, but spends early wallclock on a cheaper one-tail-block training path and switches back to the full two-block recurrent tail later. This is a new recurrence-scheduling experiment rather than another small LR sweep: it targets the underexplored hypothesis that the earlier recurrent block is worth using for the final exact int8 endgame but not for every early step on a 600s Mac-mini budget.
title: Shallow-Then-Full Tail Recurrence Schedule
